ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) with high-intensity (light-grey/white) pixels restricted to the distal extremities, approximately a 1:6 high-to-low intensity distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct light-grey zones: a fragmented mottled cluster at the left lobe apex and a more contiguous, triangular patch on the right lobe apex starting from the trailing edge and tapering medially.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a shallow vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth linear boundary with low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations; terminal left edge shows high-frequency, irregular pixel deviations due to surface encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curve sweeping laterally and upwards from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of raised, circular, high-contrast pixel formations (barnacle colonizations) located at the distal-most point of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable structural thickening and irregular, jagged topography at the apex of the left lobe compared to the more tapered right lobe apex.
